mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in harvesting pasture species in Nigeria, due to their high efficiency compared to manual methods such as using cutlasses etc."

Hay is the most common method of forage conservation in Nigeria.

The inflorescence or flower is the reproductive part of the grass.

Forage refers to any aboveground plant material used for feeding livestock, but excluding concentrates and other industrial by-products.

Certain desirable characters are considered in established pasture specie.
